correctness.rationale: Exact pinned multiplication table gives x=(μ+d)e1+μe2+Σ(u_i a_i+v_i b_i)+ρ p1+σ p2, with three free central coordinates; commutators reduce to d_i w_j-d_j w_i=0 and ω(w_i,w_j)=0 on nondegenerate alternating k^{2r}, including characteristic two. For some d_i≠0, rows (d_i,w_i) have rank ≤1, whose closure D is irreducible determinantal cone of dimension (m+2r)+3m. With all d_i=0, commuting is the isotropic-span locus I. Its maximal-rank s=min(m,r) stratum fibering over IG(s,2r) with surjection fiber is irreducible, and its closure contains every lower-rank isotropic tuple by extension of its image, giving dimension 3m+sm+s(2r-s)-binom(s,2). Their intersection is rank-one w of dimension 4m+2r-1. At r=1 all pairwise orthogonal vectors in k² collinear, so I⊂D; at r≥2 independent vectors in an isotropic plane prove both components occur. Rank-t isotropic finite-field subspaces counted by ∏(q^{2r-i}-q^i)/(q^t-q^i), times onto maps F_q^m→F_q^t and q^{3m} free coordinates; open d≠0 contributes (q^m-1)q^{2r}. Independently enumerated commuting pairs of the quotient over F2 for r=1,2,3, obtaining 22,184,2272, matching formula. No assertion about nonreduced schemes.
